name: African and Overseas Enterprises Limited
source: African and Overseas Enterprises Limited audited consolidated financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026, cash flow statement page 48 of the FY2026 Integrated Annual Report, R thousands read as absolute ZAR. CRON 2026-11-18: FY2026 and FY2025 columns added. Operating, investing and financing flows are the printed subtotals (101,312 and 119,648 operating, -19,146 and -75,633 investing, -43,467 and -26,095 financing) and tie to the printed net increase in cash (38,699 and 17,920). Capital Expenditure is the printed purchase of property plant and equipment, investment property and intangible assets added together (-42,555 and -53,880) and Free Cash Flow adds it to operating cash flow on the file existing convention.
